CORRECTED_HOW_TO_READ_A_CELL.status: NORMATIVE FOR THE EFFECTIVE CONTRACT. Closes S-11.
CORRECTED_HOW_TO_READ_A_CELL.corrected_text: A cell's status value carries a PROVENANCE CLASS, not a single uniform confidence - see MATRIX_PROVENANCE_CORRECTION (predecessor amendment) for the class of every cell. EXECUTED means the value is MEASURED EVIDENCE: the real handler was invoked in process and the response recorded, without hosted execution. TEST_FROZEN means the value is pinned by a real, committed, currently-passing test, though not executed by the authoring lane itself. DERIVED_FROM_SOURCE means the value is a CONTRACT DERIVATION - established by reading the handler's source only - and is NOT measured evidence of any kind; an implementation lane must convert it into a test before it can be relied on as evidence. required_* is the CONTRACT regardless of a cell's provenance class. Where a cell carries required_status it is settled and an implementation lane has no discretion. Where it carries required_status_if_* it is NOT settled, and the named OD must be ratified before any implementation lane may choose among the branches.
